Reviewer readback rejected: docs/04/l12_fleet_runtime_reliability_20260729/report.md contradicts live runtime truth on 3 of 5 acceptance items. (1) Claude-family run facts inverted: report cites run claude2-20260729T024210Z-b4144cf6 as 'Healthy / Active, currently running L12-MANIFEST-HC-ALPHA-SRC-20260729', but /home/lupin/pantheon/.orchestrator/worker-runtime/status/claude2-20260729T024210Z-b4144cf6.json records status=failed, exit_code=143, signal=15, finished_at=2026-07-29T02:47:04Z; today claude2 is 4 failed(143/15) + 3 completed + 1 running of 8, and antigravity1-1 is 5 failed(143/15) of 8 - neither failure set is recorded, yet the conclusion says 'fully functional'. (2) Codex2 facts fabricated: report claims Codex2 is Active with '90+ retried runs'; worker-runtime/status has ZERO codex2-* files (0 of 1581). Real fallback facts are unrecorded: codex ran 51 times on 20260729 with 47 failed exit_code=143/signal=15 and 4 running. (3) Provider table models invented: report lists claude2=claude-3-5-sonnet and codex/codex2=gpt-4o/o1, but live provider_capabilities.json has selected_model=null and supported_models=[] for claude2, codex, codex2 (only antigravity/antigravity1-1 has gemini-3.6-flash-low); the table also asserts auth_ready:true fleet-wide while claude and claude1-1 are auth_ready=false / auth_not_ready. (4) SIGTERM acceptance unmet: the ~56 SIGTERM-terminated runs today are reduced to one parenthetical attributing exit 143 to Codex2 'when no pending task work is queued' - an unverified cause attributed to an agent with no runs; context-canceled / no-op / missing-pid loop evidence is absent entirely. (5) Command-root acceptance thin: no PANTHEON_COMMAND_ROOT path or PANTHEON_COMMAND_RUNTIME_SHA (a6d56c366f7436574e6d2d241b47564558beac74) recorded. PASSING: no .orchestrator/config.json edit - diff vs origin/dev is exactly one file, report.md. VERIFIED-OK: PR #4330 mergeCommit d9cbbbfa2b0d4076f939a6d0fcc921406993d7af and the LLM-Agent: Codex / Reviewer: Antigravity trailer mismatch on 7b68b4235. REQUIRED FIXES: rebuild the inventory from worker-runtime/status/*.json run records and live provider_capabilities.json only, cite run_id + status + exit_code + signal per claim, drop every unsourced model name and any Codex2 activity claim, add a per-agent SIGTERM loop section with counts and run ids, and record the command root + runtime sha. Also note process gaps for closeout: bc4b14fbf is a local anchor commit only - no branch push and no PR exists, and no review_file evidence manifest exists for this task.

Reviewer Claude2 獨立核對 PR #4333 (head 57a5e485e, docs/04/l12_fleet_runtime_reliability_20260729/report.md) 後退回，三項 acceptance 未達成。

[1] acceptance 'live supervisor command root is verified' 驗證錯誤。report.md:12 寫 PANTHEON_COMMAND_ROOT = /home/lupin/pantheon，但實際是 /home/lupin/pantheon-ci-deploy/dev-root。反證來自 report 自己聲稱讀過的檔案：每個 worker-runtime status file 都帶 status_command_runtime = {command_root: /home/lupin/pantheon-ci-deploy/dev-root, source_sha: a6d56c366f7436574e6d2d241b47564558beac74, remote: ajoe734/pantheon, base_ref: origin/dev}，且 status file 的 command[0] 是 /home/lupin/pantheon-ci-deploy/dev-root/.orchestrator/bin/codex。report.md:13 引用的 SHA a6d56c36 正是 dev-root 的 HEAD；git -C /home/lupin/pantheon rev-parse HEAD = f1d8c708，與該 SHA 不符。/home/lupin/pantheon 是 live supervisor root，不是 command root，兩者必須分開陳述。

[2] acceptance 'Codex and Codex2 fallback run facts are recorded' 記錄了假的否定結論。report.md:18 與 §2 表格宣稱 codex2 有 0 runs（0 of 1581 status files）。實際上 Codex2 身分的 run 確實存在，只是 status file 的 agent 欄位把所有 codex slot 收斂成 'codex'，provider slot 不在該欄位裡。具體反證：codex-20260729T023942Z-c48d0202 與 codex-20260729T024015Z-85008a8f 兩個 status file 的 command prompt 明寫『你的 auto worker 身分是：Codex2』，且 supervisor log (.orchestrator/logs/supervisor-watchdog-restart-20260728T132125Z.log) 對同一組 run id 標記 provider=codex2-1 / codex2-2。該 log 今日 170 筆 supersede 事件的 provider 分佈為 codex1-1=36, claude2=25, codex2-1=20, codex1-2=20, antigravity1-1=20, codex2-2=18, codex1-3=9, codex2-3=8, codex1-4=7, claude1-1=5, codex2-4=2。請改以 provider slot 而非 agent 欄位歸戶，重算 §2/§3；同理 §3A 標題 'Codex SIGTERM Loop' 把 47 次終止全歸給單一 codex 也是誤植。

[3] acceptance 'repeated SIGTERM context-canceled no-op missing-pid loops are documented' 未達成。report 只統計 exit_code 143 / signal 15 的次數，成因寫成推測性的『supervisor lifecycle/preemption/timeout』，全文未引用 supervisor log，也完全沒有 context-canceled / no-op / missing-pid 迴圈的任何記錄。實際可觀察機制就在 supervisor log：每次 SIGTERM 前都有對應的 'worker superseded: task=... provider=... run=...'，例如 run=codex-20260729T023942Z-c48d0202 在 10:55:15 被 superseded、status file finished_at=2026-07-29T02:54:27Z exit 143。請以該 log 為證據來源，把 supersede -> SIGTERM 的重複迴圈寫成可再現的因果記錄；若 context-canceled / no-op / missing-pid 三種訊號在現有 log 中確實不存在，也必須明講已用哪些路徑與關鍵字搜尋過、結果為空，不能靜默略過 acceptance 項目。

已通過、不需重做的部分：§1 provider 矩陣與 /home/lupin/pantheon/.orchestrator/provider_capabilities.json (generated_at 2026-07-28T19:29:22Z) 逐項相符（antigravity 家族 auth_ready=true/gemini-3.6-flash-low、claude 與 claude1-* auth_ready=false、claude2 auth_ready=true selected=null、codex/codex2 全 slot auth_ready=true）；唯一缺漏是未列 gemini (auth_ready=false)，建議補上。今日 run 總數與各項計數在時間漂移範圍內可重現（我重跑為 73 runs / 59 次 143，對應 report 快照時的 69 / 57）。.orchestrator/config.json 確認未被改動。PR #4333 的 Commit trailers CI 已在 57a5e485e 轉為 SUCCESS。另經 scripts/loop_done_guardrail.py::check_task 對 canonical row dry-run，本 task 無 product-evidence gap，不需要 review_file manifest。

修正後請重新推 PR 並轉回 review。
